text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from y.
English(x) ::: x is in English.
Foreign(x) ::: x is a foreign literature.
Question: 
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Harry Potter was published by New Vessel Press.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → Book(x) ∧ y = NewVesselPress) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
NeapolitanChronicles :::
TranslatedFrom(NeapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(NeapolitanChronicles, NewVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was published by New Vessel Press.
PublishedBy(PalaceOfFlies, NewVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies was published by New Vessel Press.
